# Autofix Merge Gate 1.0.0

First stable release of the review Skill for agent-generated security-fix pull requests.

Use the Skill to map every code-scanning alert to its patch and validation evidence, keep CodeQL and behavioral tests as separate gates, inspect sensitive scope expansion, and produce a human-owned merge decision.

Assets include the iPolloWork installer, a standalone Skill ZIP, source ZIP, and SHA-256 checksums.
